name: Lacosamide
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Cleared by both renal excretion of parent drug and metabolism. CYP3A4/CYP2C9/CYP2C19 form O-desmethyllacosamide; urinary elimination includes unchanged lacosamide and metabolites.
